messages:
maria: Quick question — we keep hitting friction when teams want to save a per-route query but the route owner is a different team. Proposal: add a 'delegated_saves' ACL on routes so owners can grant save/publish rights to other teams. Thoughts?

ajay: Curious — is this about UI convenience or about permissioning for programmatic saves (API)?

maria: Both. Most infra teams can save in the UI today if they own the route, but product teams want to save model-aware views for routes they don't own. Also need API support for infra to write saved queries in bulk.

sam: UI note: we should avoid adding extra buttons. Maybe a dropdown on the route header: "Manage save access" that opens a compact modal. Defaults: route owner only. Delegation = select team or user.

leo: UX flag: if delegations are common, lists will become noisy. We should show a single line "Saved by X (team) — managed" and an affordance to view full list. Keep the main route card terse.

kelly: Operational concern: saved queries count toward per-namespace quota and telemetry sampling. Delegated saving increases cardinality — we need clearer quota guidance and maybe a soft-limit alert (telemetry event) when a route has >50 saved views.

maria: Good point — we should include telemetry events for create/delete and a metric `route.saved_views.count` exported to console. That lets SRE & billing detect growth.

ajay: API contract idea: extend POST /saved_queries with `scope: ["route","team","org"]` and an optional `route_id` plus `delegated_by` for audit. Example:```json
{
  "name":"Latency p95 - model A",
  "scope":"route",
  "route_id":"rt_abc123",
  "query":"...",
  "delegated_by":"team:infra"
}
```

sam: If we add `delegated_by`, UI can surface provenance. Also we should have a toggle for "public to route" vs "private to team" when saving.

nora: Legal/compliance check — if a saved query contains a sampling of requests or prompt text, delegation might expose PII across teams. We need a data exposure audit when delegation is granted; maybe require route owners to attest.

kelly: Ops asks for an enforcement knob: a route-level feature flag `allow_delegated_saves` (default off). We can roll it on per-customer or per-org. That helps on-prem/private customers who want stricter controls.

maria: Rollout plan suggestion: start with backend + API, opt-in flag on routes, then small UI for owners to grant delegation. Canary: enable for 5 internal routes, measure `route.saved_views.create` and `route.saved_views.unique_creators`.

ajay: Implementation concerns: routing plane will need to check ACLs on save time — cheap. But we must also ensure read-time filtering: when a user views route analytics, they should only see saved queries visible to them (scope + delegation). We'll need a small change in the route-inspector endpoint.

sam: UX question: should delegated saved queries appear in team libraries or only under the route's saved list? I'd vote both but mark provenance.

leo: Marking provenance is key. Use a small pill "saved by infra (delegated)". It reduces confusion.

maria: Action items: 1) Ajay draft API contract and auth checks; 2) Sam + Leo sketch UI affordance and provenance pill; 3) Kelly + Nora define telemetry and compliance gating; 4) I'll schedule a 30m sync after drafts.

ajay: Will drop a PR for the API spec today with proposed error codes: 403 if not allowed, 409 if duplicate name under same scope.

deploy-bot: new-deploy: api-spec/acl-delegation branch pushed by ajay — CI passed. :rocket:

maria: Nice. Thanks everyone — want to iterate on the API doc first then UI.

kelly: One more: add a background job to reconcile orphaned delegated saves when a team is deleted. Telemetry event for reconciliation run.

nora: I'll add a short checklist for attestations to the draft — will share before the sync.

maria: Great. Sync invite incoming. :thumbsup:
